/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
import re
df = pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=None)
header = df.iloc[4]
data = df.iloc[5:].copy()
data.columns = header
# Keep only rows with Visit ID not null
data = data[data['Visit ID'].notna()]
# Normalize village names
def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    s = str(s).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
data['Village_norm'] = data['Village'].apply(norm)
# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# Filter
mask = (
    data['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'odisha'
) & (
    data['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'health & nutrition'
)
filtered = data[mask]
total_women = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Women Reached'], errors='coerce').sum()
print('rows', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Visit ID','State','Programme','Women Reached']].head())
print('total', total_women)
\"
"
